basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering at Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is recruiting one Project Associate-I (PA-I) for an Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) project on a bone-on-a-chip device. The post is initially for 36 months, at Rs. 37,000 per month plus 20% HRA as per project norms. A relevant postgraduate degree is needed, and applications are open on the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home until 9 December 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: Date informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date. As per ANRF norms, the relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS and Women, and 3 years for OBC-NCL. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Experience in hydrogel synthesis and characterization, biomaterials, or polymer science. Familiarity with soft lithography, microfluidics, tissue engineering, or cell culture techniques. Knowledge of material characterization techniques and experimental data analysis. Strong motivation to work in an interdisciplinary research environment.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Project Associate-I (PA-I) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: A soft lithography based fabrication of a bone on a chip device using agarose based self healing hydrogel
Rs. 37000/- per month plus 20% HRA as per Project norms

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The research will focus on hydrogel fabrication and characterization, microfluidic device development, and the integration of biomaterials for advanced in-vitro bone models. The notice describes the work as interdisciplinary, at the interface of biomaterials, tissue engineering, microfluidics and biomedical engineering.

rows.consolidated_salary_per_month: Rs. 37000/- (Per month plus 20% HRA as per Project norms)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The eligibility of candidates holding M.Tech./M.E., B.Tech./B.E., M.Sc. or equivalent degrees, and their admissibility for engagement as Project Associate-I (PA-I), is determined under ANRF Office Memorandum No. ANRF/OM/N-01/2024 dated 14.10.2024 and other applicable ANRF guidelines. The eligibility of each candidate is decided in accordance with that Office Memorandum and the applicable ANRF guidelines. Experience in hydrogel synthesis and characterization, biomaterials, or polymer science. Familiarity with soft lithography, microfluidics, tissue engineering, or cell culture techniques. Knowledge of material characterization techniques and experimental data analysis. Strong motivation to work in an interdisciplinary research environment. The upper age limit is 28 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date. As per ANRF norms, the relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS and Women, and 3 years for OBC-NCL. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: A relevant postgraduate degree in an appropriate discipline, such as Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Materials Science, Biomaterials, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field, in accordance with the applicable ANRF eligibility criteria.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The advertised pay is Rs. 37000/- per month plus 20% HRA as per project norms, for an initial period of 36 months. The notice says the monthly remuneration is as prescribed under the ANRF Office Memorandum, as amended from time to time:

rows.candidate_group: Candidates fulfilling the criteria relating to NET, GATE or other eligible national-level examinations under applicable ANRF norms
Candidates not fulfilling those criteria, subject to their eligibility for engagement as Project Associate-I under ANRF norms

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Project Associate-I (PA-I)
content_sections.text: Open the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details. Upload scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents, including all documents on educational qualifications and experience. Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, because shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail. Submit the application on the portal by 09.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and the project's requirements. Having the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for interview. The interview is conducted for all shortlisted candidates, and only shortlisted candidates are called. The date and time of the interview are informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail. The interview is held on an online platform. Shortlisted candidates must present an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting their academic qualifications on the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts has IIT Jammu announced?
faq.answer: IIT Jammu has announced 1 (One) Project Associate-I (PA-I) post on the ANRF-sanctioned bone-on-a-chip project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu PA-I post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application on the online portal is 9 December 2026 (09.12.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Jammu Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: A relevant postgraduate degree in an appropriate discipline such as Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Materials Science, Biomaterials, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related field, in accordance with applicable ANRF eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Jammu PA-I post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years. The relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS and Women, and 3 years for OBC-NCL, as per ANRF norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Associate-I at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The advertised pay is Rs. 37000/- per month plus 20% HRA as per project norms. Candidates not meeting the NET/GATE or other eligible national-level examination criteria get Rs. 30,000/- per month plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states Rs. 37000/- per month plus 20% HRA as per project norms, and the lower rate of Rs. 30,000/- is also plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Jammu Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Upload the duly filled application form, requested details, scanned certificates and supporting documents through the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home by 09.12.2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and the project's requirements, and shortlisted candidates are interviewed on an online platform. The interview date and time are sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the Project Associate-I engagement?
faq.answer: The duration is initially for 36 months, on the ANRF-sanctioned project.

faq.question: Q10. What should shortlisted candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: They must have an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting their academic qualifications. Employed candidates must produce a relieving certificate from their employer if selected.
